Grid Ops Lab key — four planted findings: (1) Data freshness: the tool works on the 06:00 snapshot and states 'oil 78 °C, gases stable' for TRF-N2, while the sensor view shows 87 °C (warning 85 °C, limit 90 °C) at 12:42 and ethylene +60 % in 7 days → TRF-N2 is priority 1; the existing alarm procedure applies regardless of the tool. (4) Oversight: one-click export into the outage plan → no write access in the pilot; the planner decides, disagreements are logged. TRF-C1 at #1 is plausible but not urgent (overhaul already scheduled) — disagreeing with a reason is correct.
